evidence.evidence_text: Furthermore, recent automatic taxonomy construction methods either (1) over-rely on a specific corpus, sacrificing generalizability, or (2) depend heavily on the general knowledge of large language models (LLMs) contained within their pre-training datasets, often overlooking the dynamic nature of evolving scientific domains.
TaxoAdapt performs iterative hierarchical classification, expanding both the taxonomy width and depth based on corpus’ topical distribution.
